hypotheses.latent_object: F(t)=f(t), the common univariate function underlying both members
hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member is recovered from the latent object F by its operator: O_G0001[F]=(F(x)-F(y))/(x-y) and O_G0002[F]=F'(x), the latter being the y->x coalesced-node divided-difference case.
required_assumptions: F(t)=f(t) is the common univariate function
x and y are symbolic variables; the G0001 branch assumes Ne(x,y)
G0002 uses the coincident-node/limit case and requires differentiability of f at x
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The two catalog members are structural divided-difference companions: G0001 is the first divided difference at distinct nodes x,y, while G0002 is the derivative at x obtained by coalescing the nodes. They share the same univariate latent function F and differ only by node multiplicity.
